Confirmed. giiker.com lists 'SUPERCUBE i3S' at $39.99 with available=false. TheCubicle's 'XiaoMi Giiker Cube' ($41.99) is tagged Availability_Discontinued and is unavailable. cuboss search for 'giiker' returns nothing, and SCS search finds no Giiker. The SWB giiker.ts constants match: 0xaadb/0xaadc, a 36-byte DECRYPT_KEY applied when raw[18] === 0xa7, and cubeTimestamp null.

'Only cubing.js implements its BLE protocol' is wrong. HEYKUBE's own Python library is MIT-licensed, controls the cube over BLE, and is documented at heykube-python.readthedocs.io with source at github.com/heykube/heykube_python. Among the browser drivers, cubing.js is the only one (SWB and csTimer have no HeyKube code). The availability part is confirmed: TheCubicle says 'This product has been discontinued indefinitely or we aren't sure when it will be back in stock' ($99.99, tag Availability_Discontinued), while heykube.com shows '$69.95 IN STOCK', '(c) 2022, HEYKUBE' and an open Python API.
evidence: https://heykube-python.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ ('Free software: MIT license'; Edit on GitHub -> github.com/heykube/heykube_python)

Confirmed. atoutcubes files the 'Monster Go AI Bluetooth 3x3' under /plus-distribue/ ('no longer distributed') at EUR 26.90, OutOfStock. SWB defines the Gen1 service 0000fff0 plus Device Information 180a, LZ-compressed key blobs and a poll loop. The MHC nameFilter is namePrefix 'MHC'. 'AiCube' devices use the Gen2 driver with GAN_ENCRYPTION_KEYS[1] and get gyroscope=false.

missing: MoYu Super WeiLong V2 AI is a current MoYu smart 3x3 that the research does not mention. It sells in the EU: atoutcubes lists 'MoYu Super WeiLong V2 AI (Ball-Core Maglev UV)' at EUR 139.90 and the 18th Anniversary edition at EUR 169.90, both in stock. It is absent from the SCS and TheCubicle smart collections. csTimer issue #488 (closed 'not planned' on 2025-08-02) reports that 'The cube is recognized, but does not record cube turns', and no open driver names it. Its protocol is therefore unknown and possibly not MoYu32. Sources: https://www.atoutcubes.com/en/3x3-cubes/67548-super-weilong-v2-ai-18th-anniversary-4000000020264.html and https://github.com/cs0x7f/cstimer/issues/488

GAN i4 endurance mode may stop move reporting, not only the gyro. GAN's page says '200-hr Marathon. Gyroscope off. Recording disabled for minimal drain.' Rouxtine should test what a Gen4 i4 sends in this mode and tell users to use Performance ('30-hr Burst. Gyroscope on.') for timed solves. Source: https://www.gancube.com/products/gan-i4-smart-cube

The GAN16 ui MAX's 45 h battery figure counts its charging pod: '15h standalone + 30h via GanPod'. The cube alone lasts 15 h. Sources: https://www.gancube.com/products/gan16-ui-maglev-max and https://speedcubeshop.com/products/16-ui-maglev-max-uv

GAN's own i-Series comparison table (i Carry E, i Carry 4, i Carry 2) lists all three as non-rechargeable and without a gyroscope, at about 150 h, 150 h and 700 h. So none of the cheap GANs gives orientation data. Source: https://www.gancube.com/products/gancube-gan356-i-carry-e-smart-cube

An unlabelled SWB Gen2 capture may cover the i Carry E. Fixture 'GANicXXX' reports HARDWARE hardwareName 'GANicEqV', software 3.12, gyroSupported false. SWB treats 'GANicXXX' as an advertising alias of 'GANic*' names. csTimer shows the 'GANic' prefix is shared with the GAN251 ui 2x2 ('GANic251'). Sources: https://github.com/poliva/smartcube-web-bluetooth/blob/2077416d6c828ec926dee424cf1bbfe4c0f25a47/captures/fixture_GANicXXX_gan-gen2_2026-04-14T11-39-47.json and https://github.com/cs0x7f/cstimer/blob/5f8e46cb78da6a487fc01ba913a6ce6fd101e28d/src/js/hardware/gancube.js#L362

atoutcubes.com (FR) is a much broader EU source than cuboss. Smart 2x2s are on the same shelves and some connect through the same drivers. GAN251 ui sells for $71.96-79.99 in the US and EUR 79.99 at cuboss. SWB lists support for the MoYu WeiPo V5 AI 2x2 ('WCU_MY22', MoYu32 driver with 24 facelets, added 2026-10-17). A Roux-only 3x3 app must detect and reject 2x2s; SWB and csTimer tell them apart by name ('GAN251', 'GANic251', 'WCU_MY22'). Sources: https://github.com/poliva/smartcube-web-bluetooth/blob/2077416d6c828ec926dee424cf1bbfe4c0f25a47/README.md#L40-L48 and https://cuboss.com/shop/gan-251-m-ui-2x2-smart-cube-ball-core-uv/

TheCubicle re-listed the GAN12 ui MagLev as a 'PowerPod, 2026 Edition' ($119.99, 2026-06-11). Every public capture of a GAN12 ui is the older Gen2 'GAN12ui'. The GAN356 i3 V2 is sold only at TheCubicle; it is not on gancube.com or at SCS. TheCubicle describes it as rechargeable (15 h), with a gyroscope and 'Smart Core 3.0', so it differs from the i Carry line. Source: https://www.thecubicle.com/products/gan356-i3-v2-3x3
